listing.name: Epitaph Frost
listing.aiSummary: Adds several high-tech ships and exploration hullmods.

description:
Misc ship / hullmods pack
Adds
-Stheno high-tech escort destroyer, for when a Medusa is too fast.
-Khepri class high-tech super-capital, which really should be a unique boss encounter but that requires coding.
-Borealis class high-tech cruiser, for when you want a 35 DP super cruiser that isn't Doom.
-Reinforcer class cruiser. Essentially an Enforcer in cruiser size.
-Quest class battleship, all of the firepower of a conquest with none of the mobility.
-Fluorescence class light cruiser, to give the Remnants a light cruiser.

Also adds several hullmods that can be found through exploration.

Download

Screenshots

Balance status: slightly less sillly

Changelog
2.0.0- (hopefully) doesn't screw up procgen anymore. Removed Vestige/Verglas to cook a bit more. Removed Particle Collator.

Credits
Lots of stuff got cut in 2.0.0- hope to bring it back sometime.
Thanks to DarkRevenant for code snippets.
Tomatopaste and ruddythegreat for troubleshooting,
SirHartley for armor regen code.
On-hit effect, damage listeners copied from BadDragn's Apex.
Aero for helping standardize
Lukas for custom system stuff
TheDragon for fancy graphics
Tarfilette for the very cool Victus system- no longer in
